aiMetadata.description: Send a question or prompt to a specific Dashworks bot and get back a generated, knowledge-grounded answer. Use when an agent needs Dashworks to answer using its connected company knowledge sources. Requires the target bot ID; optionally toggle inline markdown source citations in the answer. Not idempotent — each call generates a fresh answer.
